counter_scope: Terminal counters are cumulative across kernel prints; use final cumulative total, not sum of all cumulative prints. Per-kernel cycles are separate increments. L2 accepted read sectors exclude reservation-fail retry attempts. Read misses=GLOBAL_ACC_R MISS+SECTOR_MISS. DRAM reads=issued32B atoms. Aggregate stall event counts are not wall-cycle fractions.

definitions.Tag_evictions: Logical Tag mapping replacements; not synonymous with Tag-bank arbitration conflicts or proven redundant fetches.
definitions.OO_duplicate_after_eviction: UNAVAILABLE in terminal output; never inferred as0.
definitions.service_means: Read-retired conditioned quantities; populations/timing can differ across modes. Not causal subtractions.
definitions.PIB_mean: Time-weighted sum over all sampled SMs including idle SMs; no saturation verdict from mean alone.
definitions.gpu_stall_dramfull: Legacy label for aggregate ICNT-to-memory input/backpressure events, not direct DRAM utilization or unique DRAM-full cycles.
definitions.L1D_total_cache_misses: Cannot compare across the conventional read path and the DTC OO read path as if both counted all identical events.

facts: Within DTC, hash reduces tag evictions, new line/lower read requests and accepted L2 read bytes by roughly78-81%; cycles decrease about23-24%.

Both CM/CH and DM/DH have zero modeled DRAM reads in these exact input runs. This is consistent with their reused small working sets and memcpy-initialized L2, not ideal-L2: -l2_ideal=0 and -gpgpu_perf_sim_memcpy=1.
Hash preserves bank bits; the finite OO terminal output does not print Tag-bank conflict or duplicate-after-eviction counters. They are unavailable, not zero.
findings.supported_association: Source changes only fixed row indexing within each design; fewer row replacements/new requests strongly support a Tag placement/reuse mechanism, with reduced L1-to-L2/interconnect pressure. This is not direct measurement of bank collision reduction or redundant unique-data transfers.
unproven: Conflict-versus-capacity miss split without a shadow/tag reference model.
Per-request repeated lower fetch counts and exact causal portion of the speedup.
Ready-conditioned mean differences are not causal cycle savings; they rise after hash here while whole-input cycles fall.

facts: Selected full captures have16 CTAs in each256-thread kernel on64SM; at most16SM can execute blocks for a kernel simultaneously.
After hash, DTC sends fewer L2 read sectors than CH but issues more DRAM read atoms: the accepted L2 read-miss fraction is higher.
The strided matrix traversal kernel accounts for over93% of DH whole-input cycles.
OO completion-service post-ready means remain a few cycles; global time-mean PIB occupancy is small, but includes idle SMs and does not prove zero PIB-full episodes.
findings.supported_association: Remaining adverse cross-design performance is associated with low CTA concurrency, the strided kernel, L2 read residency/miss behavior and downstream backpressure. Hash repairs a substantial Tag mapping effect but does not eliminate the downstream work or the different modeled C/D service/capacity constraints.
unproven: Exact allocation versus timing/reordering contribution to the higher L2 read-miss fraction and DRAM reads.
Whether a particular finite service port is the critical limiter; lack of a printed stall category is not a zero count.
Physical-GPU performance, area-matched superiority, or transferable numerical values.
